govdocs-archive_org-nsia-EpsteinEdwardJa:
Edward Jay Epstein reported for The New Yorker in its A Reporter at Large series on February 13, 1971. His subject was the Chicago police raid of December 4, 1969, in which Black Panther chairman Fred Hampton was killed. The article's title asks a hard question: The Panthers and the Police: A Pattern of Genocide?

Epstein examined the raid as part of a wider pattern of police action against the Panthers. Hampton's death had already become a national controversy over how the raid was planned and carried out. The piece preserves a major magazine's close reporting on that fight, written while the case was still unfolding.
